what: On hover, all the large inner letters dim to half, then flash one at a time in shuffled order at .05s intervals (brightness 0%→200%), going back and forth over .15s to return to normal brightness — like a broken sign switching on

options.dur: Half-length of the flash (seconds), default .15 (doubled for a round trip)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to flash (child) — if none, the element’s own text

note: On touch devices (hover false), it flashes once on press. The original wraps each character in a span and does not make word chunks. Use it on single-line English titles, not on multi-line Korean sentences.

from.where: index.html .va__list a > h3 (large English behavior guideline) — original textBlinkAnimate: letters start at opacity .5·brightness(0%), then in shuffled order with delay i×.05 yoyo once to opacity 1·brightness(200%) over .15s, then settle at 1·100%
